text:
Priya: Quick thought — rooftop sundowners + puzzle night next Thu 6:301:30? Low-key, bring a small snack or a 30010-piece puzzle to share, BYO drink or mocktail. Sunset view + blankets. :sunrise_over_mountains:
Liam: love that. is the roof available? id prefer chill music not loud DJs.
Chen: checked with facilities, roof is fine for up to 50 people as long as we keep hours and music low. 6:30 works for me. i can bring two puzzles and a small bluetooth speaker (low vol). :headphones:
Rosa: i'll bring finger food and GF options. can we do a simple sign-up so we don't double-up? emoji RSVP would be easiest. :salad:
Ian: if we need to rent blankets or extra chairs, can finance cover or should we split? happy to chip in. :money_with_wings:
Priya: i made a tiny sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1ExampleShare (cols: name, snack, puzzle/blanks, allergies, can-carry) 1:00pm sign-up cutoff. react :thumbsup: to RSVP, :moneybag: if you can contribute to rentals.
Liam: :thumbsup: counting me in. i can also help set up at 6pm.
Chen: i'll curate a mellow playlist and share link. please add 23 tracks max so it stays chill.
Rosa: family-friendly? some folks might bring partners.
Priya: partners welcome as long as they RSVP. also please label food with allergens. i'll print labels and a short note.
calendar-bot: Event "Rooftop Sundowners + Puzzle Night" created on Thu from 18:30 to 20:30. Location: HQ Roof Deck. RSVP set to optional.
Ian: :moneybag: i can contribute $40 toward blankets/chairs, mark me down.
Priya: thanks! last ask 1:00 — please react in 24h so i can finalize rentals. see you on the roof :) :sparkles:
